identity.title: Ticketing System Quick-Start for New Hires

course.claim: New hires can log, route, and close a support ticket correctly on their first day without a supervisor watching.
course.non_claims: Does not certify advanced ticket triage, SLA management, or escalation authority.

live_problem.situation: New hires open tickets in the wrong queue, skip required fields, and escalate issues that should be self-resolved, creating rework for senior staff.
live_problem.purpose: A new hire can independently create a correctly-routed, correctly-tagged ticket within their first shift.

learner.prior_knowledge: Comfortable with basic web forms; no prior exposure to this specific ticketing tool or the team's queue structure.
learner.barriers: No time for a multi-day onboarding course; must be usable async, on day one, in under 2 hours.

opens: a ticket is routed by WHO owns the fix, not by how urgent it feels
changed_questions: which team actually owns this class of problem?

routes.question: Which queue does this ticket belong in?
routes.criteria: ticket lands in the queue matching the published symptom-to-queue table

capability.overall: New hire can create a correctly-routed, correctly-tagged ticket unassisted.
capability.human_return: Given a new, unseen symptom description, the hire selects the right queue from the table and fills all required fields without asking a colleague.

content.must_know: The symptom-to-queue table; the required fields for a valid ticket.
content.must_do: Create at least one real or simulated ticket end-to-end.

sessions.learner_action: Given 3 sample symptom descriptions, the learner creates 3 tickets in a sandbox instance.
sessions.evidence: 3/3 tickets land in the correct queue with all required fields filled

assessment.claim: Learner can independently create a correctly-routed ticket.
assessment.task: Create a ticket from a new, unseen symptom description in the sandbox instance.
assessment.observation: Which queue the ticket lands in; which required fields are filled.
assessment.criteria: Ticket lands in the queue matching the published symptom-to-queue table AND all required fields are non-empty.
assessment.warrant: Correct queue + complete fields on an unseen symptom is the operational definition of 'can independently create a correctly-routed ticket' for this role — there is no additional real-world task this course claims to prepare for.
assessment.assistance_condition: unassisted — no supervisor or reference material beyond the closure-pack quick-reference card, which is allowed since it ships with the role permanently.

closure_pack: link to sandbox instance for future practice
